activity.name: Bash
activity.arg:
git commit -F - <<'EOF'
c0003: levels become files, not Rust literals

Eight levels lived as `LevelDefinition` literals in `main.rs`, each pointing at a
`const LEVEL*: &str` block map a few dozen lines above it. They are now one
`assets/levels/*.ron` file each, and `assets/levels/campaign.ron` names the seven
that make up the game, in play order. `main.rs` holds no level data at all - it
inserts `Levels` from `campaign::load_levels(&campaign::levels_dir())`.

`LevelDefinition` is `#[serde(default)]`, so a file only names what it changes
from the default - the same shape the literals had with `..default()`, and short
enough that a level still reads at a glance. `distributed_global_pickups` is
`#[serde(skip)]`: it is derived from `global_pickups` and the block count when
the match starts, so authoring it would be authoring a lie.

The block map stays a multi-line ASCII map, held in a RON raw string. Writing
one back out goes through `PrettyConfig::escape_strings(false)`, which is what
keeps it from collapsing into a single `\n`-riddled line when `c0012` starts
saving from the editor.

The migration is proved rather than eyeballed. The pre-migration literals live on
in the test module, and `the_campaign_is_the_levels_that_used_to_live_in_main`
asserts the campaign loaded off disk equals them field for field - which is why
`PartialEq` now runs across the level types. The other tests cover the round trip
(parse, write, parse, write - value and text both stable), the campaign naming
only files that exist, the scratch levels staying out of the campaign, and the
distributed pickups being derived and never written.

The level directory is resolved through `FileAssetReader::get_base_path()`, the
same root the asset server uses, so this `std::fs` read and the asset loader in
`c0004` cannot drift onto different files. A missing or malformed file panics at
startup naming the path, rather than silently playing a short campaign.

Scratch levels came across too: `conveyor.ron` is the commented-out force field
level `c0001` needs, and `simple1.ron`, `demo_moving.ron` and
`demo_minimal_win_state_error.ron` were unused layout constants. None are in
`campaign.ron`. The token grid documentation moved out of `main.rs` onto
`layout::make_block`, next to the code that reads it.

Note that `src/main.rs`, `src/block/mod.rs`, `src/pickups/mod.rs` and `Cargo.toml`
also carry the Bevy 0.9 -> 0.19 migration edits that were already sitting
uncommitted in the working tree, the same way `c0002` carried them for
`src/level/layout/mod.rs`.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
